messages:
elaine-partnerships: Heads-up — we should finalize a partner SEV escalation playbook for marketplace/hardware/SI partners. Posting a draft below; @mike-sre @jess-infra please chime in.

mike-sre: This is timely. We had a messy handoff with CloudAxis last week. Happy to tighten SLA windows.

jess-infra: +1. Also want clear channel naming and automation so we don't get channel sprawl.

elaine-partnerships: Draft proposal:

- Severity definitions
  - SEV-1: Production outage (partner revenue or customer-facing broken). Target ack < 10m, mitigation < 60m.
  - SEV-2: Major degradation (large % customers impacted). Target ack < 30m, mitigation < 4h.
  - SEV-3: Functional but reduced (feature regression). Target ack < 24h, fix in next sprint.

- Channel policy
  - Short-lived dedicated warroom channel: #partner-warroom-<partner>-<yyyymmdd>
  - Persistent partner incident channel (if long-lived / recurring): #partner-<partner>-incidents
  - No ad-hoc DM escalations for SEV-1; use channel + page.

- Activation flow
  1) Partner files support ticket/phone/sales escalation -> partner success triage.
  2) If SEV-1/2 -> create warroom via Slack workflow (autocreate + add oncall, partner contacts, SRE, runtime, PM).
  3) Incident lead (partner success) runs initial triage, assigns SRE lead and eng owner.
  4) Use warroom template pinned messages + runbook links.

- Roles & paging
  - Incident lead: partner success (coordinates partner comms)
  - SRE lead: owns mitigation and postmortem
  - Runtime owner: model serving/runtime fixes
  - Eng lead: code rollbacks/patches

- Escalation matrix (contact order)
  - T1: partner success rep -> T2: oncall SRE -> T3: runtime owner -> T4: eng manager -> T5: product/exec if > 4h SEV-1

- Automation
  - Slack workflow to create warroom and post incident template
  - PagerDuty webhook to auto-page on SEV-1
  - Postmortem issue template in repo 'partner-incidents'

- Onboarding & drills
  - Add warroom playbook to partner onboarding docs
  - Quarterly tabletop drills with top-5 partners

elaine-partnerships: Example warroom template (to pin):

---
Warroom: #partner-warroom-acme-20261109
SEV: SEV-1
Incident lead: @elaine-partnerships
SRE lead: @mike-sre
Runtime owner: @jess-infra
Partner contact: Acme support hotline / acme-sev@acme.com
Initial notes:
- First ack: 10:12 UTC
- Impact: API 500s for /v1/generate
Actions:
- [ ] Page oncall
- [ ] Collect logs (guides/log-collection.md)
- [ ] Start mitigation (rollback / scale)
---

nora-ecosystems: Love the structure. Two questions: 1) For marketplace partners, do we require an SLA in the listing? 2) How do we handle partners who don't want Slack access?

sam-sales: For partners without Slack, we escalate via email + phone bridged into the warroom. Add "bridge owner" to template.

jess-infra: For automation, I can add the workflow. Proposed permissions: warrooms inherit partner channel guests via Slack shared channels; we add a temporary guest account for partner oncall.

mike-sre: Agree on pager duty integration. Also suggest we add a "fallback model" policy for hosted inference: if primary model fails, route to verified fallback (low-latency but older quant) to keep customers online.

elaine-partnerships: Great. Action items:
- @jess-infra to implement Slack workflow + shared channel guide (due 2026-01-15)
- @mike-sre to draft PD escalation policy (due 2025-12-20)
- @nora-ecosystems to update partner onboarding doc + SLA checklist (due 2026-01-05)
- @sam-sales to confirm phone bridge process with partners (due 2025-12-10)

partner-oncall-bot: Warroom created: #partner-warroom-acme-20261109. Participants: elaine-partnerships, mike-sre, jess-infra, nora-ecosystems, sam-sales.

elaine-partnerships: Thanks team — will consolidate into the final playbook and share a PR to the docs repo. If no major objections, we'll ship this next week. :thumbsup:

mike-sre: No objections from me. +1

jess-infra: Sounds good.

sam-sales: OK from sales.

nora-ecosystems: +1
